title: SeatTakeScope
description: The scope of seat.take (docs/design/m0/08 "Supervisor seat"): empty. The controller has one seat, and the caller is the supervisor taking it: a free seat is taken, a held one is asked for (seat.handover_requested), and the caller's own request is executed (seat.handed_over) once it reaches its force_after. force_after is never the caller's: the controller sets it to the request's recorded time plus the minimum grace.
